postgres_pattern_reused.evidence: Verified exact PostgreSQL integration pattern from W-008 ACaaS implementation reused across all 3 config services: telegram.config.ts, whatsapp.config.ts, comfyui.config.ts. setSessionContext/clearSessionContext, CMBCD serialization, and tenant isolation checks identical to service-postgres.repository.ts

tenant_isolation_enforced.evidence: All CRUD operations in all 3 config services enforce tenant boundary checks. setSessionContext called with tenantId before every query, clearSessionContext in finally block to prevent cross-tenant contamination. TENANT-ISOLATION-001 compliance verified.

no_new_primitives.evidence: No new Work Core primitives created. Extended existing service-directory PostgreSQL repository patterns. All modifications limited to connector-ecosystem config services only.

backward_api_compatibility.evidence: All function signatures preserved from in-memory implementation: get[X]ConfigForTenant, set[X]ConfigForTenant, delete[X]ConfigForTenant, list[X]ConfiguredTenants maintain same input/output contracts. No breaking changes to consuming code.

in_memory_storage_removed.evidence: All in-memory TenantConfigMap objects removed from telegram.config.ts, whatsapp.config.ts, comfyui.config.ts. All storage operations now use PostgreSQL tenant_channel_configs table.
